root_cause: Representation choice, not a behavior difference: Incular editing offsets are UTF-8 byte offsets into Rust strings, Flutter's are UTF-16 code units into Dart strings.
harness: text__editing_selection_offsets keeps diverging by design (3 vs 5 for emoji plus x: the same caret position expressed in different units)
limitations: Code that ports Flutter offset arithmetic literally must convert units. Every Incular boundary that carries offsets uses UTF-8 bytes: winit IME preedit ranges, incular-text editing values and selection. A rg for utf16 in crates finds conversions only in platform-menu and web segmentation code.
note: ARCHITECTURE.md hard rule 8 says Flutter is a vocabulary, not a requirement to reproduce Dart representations. Converting every offset to UTF-16 would add a conversion at each str slice for no observable gain. The finding stays in the audit as api-numeric evidence.

root_cause: Platform view embedding needs native-host compositing in each OS crate, plus a placeholder layer in incular-rendering.
limitations: Excluded by the fix pass scope, which rules out platform embedder work. It needs a product decision, and per-OS host work in incular-windows, -macos, -linux, -web and the mobile hosts.
note: Remaining work: a renderer-neutral placeholder layer with hit-test and clip participation, and native surface composition in incular-desktop and the OS crates.

root_cause: The Android host does not forward predictive back progress, and incular-navigation has no back-progress channel.
limitations: Embedder work (incular-android), excluded by the fix pass scope. It cannot be verified without a device.
note: Remaining work: a platform-neutral back-progress event in incular-platform, delivery through incular-runtime to the route outlet, and the Android mapping.

root_cause: No native undo manager bridge for text fields.
limitations: Needs native-host forwarding of platform undo and redo commands, which is embedder work excluded by scope. Keyboard undo inside EditableText is covered by the widgets layer.
note: Remaining work: an undo client on the editing session in incular-text, and command forwarding in the desktop and OS hosts.

limitations: Needs a native spell-check service in each OS host, which is embedder work excluded by scope.
note: Remaining work: a platform-neutral spell result and suggestion span in incular-text, and native providers.

limitations: Network IO is a service and host concern with no widget-observable parity behavior. A custom AssetBundle implementation works as a workaround.
note: Add it only if network assets become a product requirement.

root_cause: No scroll-aware deferral of image decoding.
limitations: A performance optimization with no observable final-state difference. The fix pass scope excludes unrelated performance work.
note: Remaining work: a provider wrapper that consults the scroll activity velocity, owned by incular-image or incular-widgets.
